data.subject: Re: Invoice discrepancy
data.body:
Hi Kwame,

On Sept 17 you wrote: "Odd. I'll look into it with our finance team and get back to you." Just checking in to see if there's any update on the invoice discrepancy. Happy to help unblock anything on our end. Let me know a good time to reconnect or if there's something you need from me. No rush, just want to keep it moving.

Sam
